blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipality of Badoc in Ilocos Norte has officially been declared a drug-cleared municipality after successfully hurdling the deliberation of the Regional Oversight Committee for the Barangay Drug Clearing Program (ROCBDC). The declaration took effect on Tuesday, Nov. 17, following the issuance of a Certificate of Drug-Cleared Municipality pursuant to ROCBDC Resolution No. 006, Series of 2026. The municipality’s application was presented before the committee, headed by Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Regional Office I Director Julius Paderes, by a delegation led by Municipal Mayor and Municipal Anti-Drug Abuse Council (MADAC) Chairman Virgilio Calajate.
